title: Seeing What's Not There
content: A couple more images from Baby Tattooville last weekend:In an atrium of the Mission Inn, there's a fountain.I sat there and sketched it, and here's one of the creatures that waddled up for a sip early one morning when no one was looking.Then a saucer descended and dropped off this guy, who was old and twice as huge before he took a sip.By the way, the BT event was covered by the TV show Nightline, so keep an eye out on that program in the next couple of weeks.
